name: Request vault
responsibility: The vault a request names, read one way for every route (?vault= first, else the body's vault field); refuses one naming none or an unreadable one, and remembers the canonical vault
description: The Express end of ADR 0049's request-vault contract, private to the server: requireVault, vaultOfRequest, statedVault and queryString. The server lends the first three to the workbench's routes through WorkbenchHooks, so a route either side mounts reads the same remembered vault (TASK-653.09).

outgoing.label: make the stated vault canonical, or the refusal
